description: Decode FCC ULS codes used by the other tools — radio service codes, station classes, license statuses, location types, antenna types, applicant types, amateur operator classes — or report coverage: which service groups this index holds, record counts, and when each was last updated. Works before the index is built. Station classes describe licensed categories, not actual on-air activity.

filter.description: radio_services and station_classes only: keep entries whose code and label contain every token given, in any order (e.g. "700 public safety" or "FB2"). Case- and accent-insensitive; punctuation separates tokens. A nonblank filter must normalize to at least one ASCII letter or digit; blank means unset. Other topics disclose that filter was not applied.

topic.description: What to list: a code vocabulary (radio_services, station_classes, license_statuses, location_types, antenna_types, applicant_types, operator_classes) or coverage, the index build state and loaded service groups.

name: fcc_spectrum_list_reference

dataAsOf.description: Creation time of the newest applied ULS file (ISO 8601); absent before the index is built.

entries.description: Decoded codes, in code order; present for every topic except coverage.

code.description: The code as filed in ULS records.

group.description: FCC bulk-data service group that carries this radio service code; radio_services only, absent for other topics and before the index is built.

indexedRecords.description: Records in the index carrying this radio service code; radio_services only, absent for other topics and before the index is built.

label.description: FCC label for the code; equal to the code when the index holds a code the bundled table lacks.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A nonblank filter on radio_services or station_classes normalizes to no searchable tokens. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

groups.description: Every weekly service group this server can index, with whether it is loaded; present for coverage.

items.description: Coverage of one weekly service group.

frequencies.description: Frequency records kept for this group (status A, L, or X licenses only); absent when not indexed.

group.description: FCC bulk-data service group name, as the FCC names its files (e.g. "LMpriv").

indexed.description: True when this group is loaded in the published index.

records.description: License and lease records indexed from this group; absent when not indexed.

sites.description: Location records kept for this group (status A, L, or X licenses only); absent when not indexed.

snapshotCreated.description: Creation time of the FCC's weekly snapshot this group was built from (ISO 8601); absent when not indexed.

index.description: Index build state; present for coverage.

antennaCoverageIncomplete.description: True when earlier decoding discarded unnumbered antenna records; searches remain available, but a complete weekly rebuild is needed.

dataAsOf.description: Creation time of the newest applied ULS file (ISO 8601).

error.description: Why the published index cannot be served, or the message of the most recent failed build or refresh.

generation.description: File name of the published index generation.

lastDailyApplied.description: Creation time of the newest daily file applied on top of the weekly snapshot (ISO 8601).

lastFullBuild.description: When the published generation finished its weekly rebuild (ISO 8601).

pathCoverageIncomplete.description: True when the generation was built before microwave paths were indexed, so a license can list no paths it files; searches remain available, but a complete weekly rebuild is needed.

ready.description: True when a completed index generation is published and searches work.

status.description: none: never built; building: a build is in progress with no published generation yet; ready: searchable.

notice.description: Guidance when a filter matched nothing, was not applied, the index is not built yet, or its antenna or path coverage needs a full rebuild.

redactIndividuals.description: True when individual licensees are redacted and excluded from name search; present for coverage.

title: List FCC ULS reference codes and coverage
